column1: # Encoded EOL corpus for the A2 candidate (#441). Shared by the C++ contract tests and, later, the Rust tests.
# Tab-separated, UTF-8, LF. Lines that are empty or start with '#' are comments. The first other line is the header.
# Columns: id, class, formats, start, units, records_off, records_on.
#   formats   : all | utf16 | utf32 | a comma list of utf16le,utf16be,utf32le,utf32be.
#   start     : first unit scanned (decimal). The region always ends after the last byte of the units column.
#   units     : '-' for no bytes, or tokens separated by one space. Tokens: CR LF NEL LS PS NUL A B C D,
#               uXXXX (a 16-bit unit, hex) and UXXXXXXXX (a 32-bit unit, hex, UTF-32 formats only).
#               A suffix ~N on the LAST token keeps only the first N bytes of that unit (a partial final unit).
#   records_* : '-' for none, or offset:width:KIND separated by ';'. Offsets and widths count units from the region start.
#               KIND is CRLF LF CR NEL LS PS. records_off is for extended EOL off, records_on for extended EOL on
# Expectations are literal; they do not come from either implementation.

column5: A CR B LF C CR LF D
